senses.gloss:
शनिः [शो-अनि किच्च Tv.]
—1 The planet Saturn (the son of the sun and represented as of a black
 colour or dressed in dark-coloured clothes).
—2 Saturday.
—3 N. of Śiva.
.━{@Comp.@}: शनिचक्रम्, शनिजम्, शनिप्रदोषः, शनिप्रसूः, शनिप्रियम्, शनिवारः, शनिवासरः

सनिः [सन्-इः Uṇ. 4. 151]
—1 Worship, service.
—2 A gift, donation.
—3 An entreaty, a respectful solicitation (f. also in this sense).
—4 Obtaining; तद्वां नरा सनये दंस उग्रमाविष्कृणोमि Bṛ. Up. 2. 5. 16.
—5 A quarter or point of the compass (f. also).
.━{@Comp.@}: सनिवन्य
शनिः + -चक्रम् Saturnʼs diagram (used for foretelling).
शनिः + -जम् black pepper.

शनिः + -प्रदोषः a term for the (evening) worship of Śiva performed
 on the thirteenth day of a lunar fortnight when it falls on a Saturday.
शनिः + -प्रसूः f. an epithet of Chāyā, wife of the sun; cf. संज्ञा.
शनिः + -प्रियम् a sapphire or emerald.
शनिः + -वारः, -वासरः Saturday.
शनिः + -वारः, -वासरः Saturday.

—1 Slowness.
—2 Graduality.
शनिर्मेहः Dysuria.

सनिः + -वन्य a. what is obtained by begging; सनिवनिप्राप्तं सनिवन्यं
 याञ्चाप्राप्तमित्यर्थः ŚB. on MS. 10. 2. 27; सनिवन्येव भृतिवचनात् MS. 10. 2. 27.
सनिकार a. Degrading (as punishment).
सनिग्रह a. Furnished with a handle; Suśr.
सनिर्विशेष a. Indifferent.
सनिर्वेद a. Dull (as conversation).
सनिर्वेद + .({@-दम्@}) ind. Despairingly.

सनित a.
—1 Granted.
—2 Gained, obtained.

सनिष्ठीवम्, -सनिष्ठेवम्
 Speech accompanied with emission of saliva, sputtered speech.

सनिष्ठीवम्, -सनिष्ठेवम्
 Speech accompanied with emission of saliva, sputtered speech.

—1 A respectful entreaty.
—2 A quarter or point of the compass.
—3 Flapping of the elephantʼs ears.
—4 Light, lustre.
—5 An epithet of Gaurī.

संनी €1 P.
—1 To bring together.
—2 To rule, govern, guide.
—3 To restore, give back.
—4 To lead towards, lead, or bring near to.
—5 To connect, unite.
—6 To mingle, mix.
—7 To arrange.
—8 To obtain, procure.
—9 To fulfill; यं यं वाञ्छति सा राजन् … तं तं समनयत् कामम्
 Bhāg. 11. 7. 56, 4. 7. 48.

सनीड(ल) a.
—1 Living in the same nest, dwelling together.
—2 Near, proximate; एतल्लतागृहसनीडकृतस्वनीडाः (पारावताः)
 Rām. Ch. 5. 67.

सनीड(ल) a.
—1 Living in the same nest, dwelling together.
—2 Near, proximate; एतल्लतागृहसनीडकृतस्वनीडाः (पारावताः)
 Rām. Ch. 5. 67.
सनीड(ल) + .{@-नीडः, -डम्@} Vicinity, neighbourhood.
सनीड(ल) + .{@-नीडः, -डम्@} Vicinity, neighbourhood.

—1 Drawing near, bringing near.
—2 Vicinity, proximity; presence; उत्कण्ठते च युष्मत्संनिकर्षस्य
 U. 6; Ku. 3. 74; R. 7. 8, 6. 20.
—3 Connection, relation.
—4 (In Nyāya phil.) Connection of an organ of sense (इन्द्रिय) with
 its object (विषय); this is of six kinds; स भूतसूक्ष्मेन्द्रियसंनिकर्षम्
 Bhāg. 2. 2. 30.
—5 A modern object or idea; वेदांश्चैके संनिकर्षं पुरुषाख्या Ms. 1. 1. 27
 (Śabara explains संनिकर्षम् as संनिकृष्टकालाः कृतका वेदा
 इदानींतनाः).

—1 Bringing near.
—2 Approaching, approximating.
—3 Proximity, vicinity.
—4 Relation, connection.
—5 Connection of an organ of sense with its object; see संनिकर्ष (4) above.

संनिकृष्ट p. p.
—1 Approximate.
—2 Proximate, adjacent, near.
संनिकृष्ट + .{@-ष्टम्@} Proximity, vicinity.
संनिचयः A collection.
संनिचित a. Constipated, stagnated; Suśr.

संनिधा €3 U.
—1 To place, put, or keep together; दूरादाहृत्य समिधः संनिदध्याद्विहायसि Ms. 2. 186.
—2 To place near; इदमनन्यपरायणमन्यथा हृदयसंनिहिते हृदयं
 मम Ś. 3. 19.
—3 To fix upon, direct towards; (दृष्टिं) पुनः सहस्रार्चिषि संनिधत्ते R. 13. 44.
—4 To draw near, approach; ध्यातैर्ध्यातैः संनिधेयं भवद्भिः Mv. 1. 50.
—5 To collect, pile up.
—6 To observe, inspect. ━Pass. To be near, be present. ━Caus.
 To collect, bring together, assemble; U. 7.
संनिधम् Vicinity.

संनिधातृ m.
—1 One who brings near.
—2 One who deposits.
—3 A receiver of stolen goods; संनिधातॄंश्च मोषस्य हन्याच्चौरमिवेश्वरः Ms. 9. 278.
—4 An officer who introduces people at court; संनिधातृचेयकर्म Kau. A. 1 also 2, 5.
—5 One who receives in charge.

संनिधानम्, संनिधिः
—1 Putting down together, juxtaposition.
—2 Proximity, vicinity, presence; असत्यामाकाङ्क्षायां संनिधानमकारणम्
 ŚB. on MS. 6. 4. 23; N. 2. 53.
—3 Perceptibility, appearance.
—4 A receptacle.
—5 Receiving, taking charge of.
—6 Combination, aggregate; दोषाणां संनिधानम् (स्त्रीयन्त्रम्) Pt. 1. 191.
—7 Depositing.
—8 The object of an organ of sense (इन्द्रियविषय).

संनिधानम्, संनिधिः
—1 Putting down together, juxtaposition.
—2 Proximity, vicinity, presence; असत्यामाकाङ्क्षायां संनिधानमकारणम्
 ŚB. on MS. 6. 4. 23; N. 2. 53.
—3 Perceptibility, appearance.
—4 A receptacle.
—5 Receiving, taking charge of.
—6 Combination, aggregate; दोषाणां संनिधानम् (स्त्रीयन्त्रम्) Pt. 1. 191.
—7 Depositing.
—8 The object of an organ of sense (इन्द्रियविषय).

संनिपत् €1 P.
—1 To alight, descend.
—2 To come together, assemble, meet together.
—3 To fall upon, attack; उद्दामेन द्विरदपतिना संनिपत्याभियुक्तः U. 3. 6.
—4 To arrive, appear.
—5 To perish, be destroyed. ━Caus.
—1 To throw or shoot down, discharge.
—2 To convoke, convene, assemble, collect together.
—3 To stretch out (a cord).
संनिपत्य ind. Immediately, directly.
संनिपात्य a. To be hurled upon; न खलु न खलु बाणः संनिपात्योऽयमस्मिन् Ś. 1. 10.

संनिपत्योपकारिन् a.
—1 That अङ्ग which serves the purpose of its प्रधान directly.
 See सामवायिक a.; संनिपत्योपकारिण एते मन्त्रा उपस्थितं
 कर्माभिदधति ŚB. on MS. 12. 1. 19.
—2 Acting immediately.

—1 Falling down, alighting, descent.
—2 Falling together, meeting; confluence; समुद्रपत्न्योर्जलसंनिपाते R. 13. 58.
—3 Collision, contact; संनिपातावधूतैश्च Mb. 4. 13. 27 (com. संनिपातोऽङ्गसंघट्टनम्);
 प्रतिपदमविहस्ताः संनिपाते रिपूणाम् Śiva B. 30. 47.
—4 Union, conjunction, combination, mixture, miscellaneous collection;
 तथा तयोः संनिपातः शरयोरभवत्तदा Mb. 3. 39. 15; Bhāg. 11. 25. 6;
 धूमज्योतिःसलिलमरुतां संनिपातः क्व मेथः Me. 5.
—5 An assemblage,
[]
 a collection, multitude, number; नानारत्नज्योतिषां संनिपातैः Ki. 5. 36;
 एको हि दोषो गुणसंनिपाते निमज्जति Ku. 1. 3.
—6 Arrival.
—7 A combined derangement of the three humours of the body causing fever
 which is of a dangerous kind.
—8 A kind of musical time or measure.
—9 Sexual intercourse; Mb. 5.
—10 Battle, war.
—11 (In astr.) A particular conjunction of planets.
.━{@Comp.@}: संनिपातज्वरः, संनिपातनिद्रा, संनिपातनुद्
संनिपातः + -ज्वरः fever arising from a vitiated state of the three humours of the body.
संनिपातः + -निद्रा swoon, trance.
संनिपातः + -नुद् m. a species of Nimba tree (Mar. नेपाळनिंब).
संनिपातकः = संनिपातः (7) above.

संनिपातित p. p.
—1 Discharged.
—2 Assembled.

संनिपातिन् a. A subsidiary that serves the purpose of the प्रधानकर्म
 by being closely connected with it or directly related (see सामवायिक
 a.); मन्त्राश्च संनिपातित्वात् MS. 12. 1. 19.

संनिबद्ध a.
—1 Connected; attached.
—2 Arranged, prepared for; संसिद्धावितिकरणीयसंनिबद्धैः (आलापैः) Ki. 7. 17.

—1 Binding firmly.
—2 Connection, attachment.
—3 Effectiveness.

संनिबर्हणम् The act of subduing, restraint; एकस्येव हि योऽशक्तो
 मनसः संनिबर्हणे Śukra. 1. 99.

संनिभ a. Like, similar (at the end of comp.); वनान्तरे तोयमिति
 प्रधाविता निरीक्ष्य भिन्नाञ्जनसंनिभं नभः Ṛs. 1. 11.

संनिभृत a.
—1 Hidden.
—2 Discreet, modest; Bhāg.
संनियुज् See नियुज्.

—1 Union, attachment.
—2 Appointment.
—3 Precept.
संनिरुध् See निरुध्.

संनिरुद्ध p. p.
—1 Restrained, suppressed.
—2 Raked together (as fire).
—3 Covered, filled; महारथौघेन न संनिरुद्धा Ki. 16. 3.

—1 Obstruction, hindrance; संसाद्य गत्या सह तेन याति विज्ञानतत्त्वं
 गुणसंनिरोधम् Bhāg. 2. 2. 30.
—2 Confinement.
—3 Narrowness; a narrow pass.

संनिवायः Combination, multitude; अष्टाधिपत्यं गुणसंनिवाये
 सहैव गच्छेन्मनसेन्द्रियैश्च Bhāg. 2. 2. 22.

संनिविश् €6 Ā.
—1 To enter into, enter deeply.
—2 To encamp, sit down.
—3 To have intercourse or intimate connection with. ━Caus.
—1 To place, put.
—2 To install or place on; धातोः स्थान इवादेशं सुग्रीवं संन्यवेशयत् R. 12. 58.
—3 To unite, join, collect.
—4 To introduce, insert, put in.
—5 To lodge, locate, station, encamp.
—6 To devolve upon, commit to, consign.
—7 To found (a town &c.).
—8 To fix the mind on.
—9 To contemplate, reflect upon.

संनिविष्ट p. p.
—1 Entered into.
—2 Collected, met together, assembled.
—3 Absorbed or engrossed in.
—4 Abiding or resting in.
—5 Contiguous, near, neighbouring.
—6 Encamped; see संनिविश् above.

—1 Deep entrance into, ardent devotion or attachment, close application.
—2 A collection, multitude, assemblage; अहं तु मन्ये तव नास्ति कश्चिदेतादृशे
 क्षत्रियसंनिवेशे Mb. 3. 268. 4.
—3 Union, combination, arrangement; विभ्रद्वपुः सकलसुन्दरसंनिवेशम्
 Bhāg. 11. 1. 10; रमणीय एष वः सुमनसां संनिवेशः Māl. 1. 9.
—4 Site, place, situation, position; स्थानान्तरे कल्पितसंनिवेशाम्
 Ku. 7. 25; R. 6. 19.
—5 Vicinity, proximity.
—6 Form, figure; उद्दामशरीरसंनिवेशः Māl. 3; निर्माणसंनिवेशः K.
—7 A hut, dwelling-place; अशून्यतीरा मुनिसंनिवेशैः R. 14. 76.
—8 Seating in the proper places, giving seats to; क्रियतां समाजसंनिवेशः U. 7.
—9 Insertion.
—10 An open space near a town where people assemble for amusement, exercise &c.
—11 The collective position of an asterism.
—12 Encampment; संनिवेशं ततश्चक्रुर्हरिवीरा महाबलाः Rām. 4. 64. 4.

—1 Settlement, abode.
—2 Erection (of a statue).

संनिवृत् €1 Ā.
—1 To return, retire.
—2 To leave off, cease, stop.
—3 To pass away. ━Caus.
—1 to cause to return, send back.
—2 To suppress, stop.
—3 To prevent, hinder.
—4 To divert, turn away from.

संनिवृत्त p. p.
—1 Returned.
—2 Stopped, ceased.
—3 Withdrawing, shrinking from.

संनिवृत्तिः f.
—1 Return; असंनिवृत्त्यै तदतीतमेव Ś. 6. 9; परलोकमसंनिवृत्तये
 यदनापृच्छय गतासि मामितः R. 8. 49, 10. 27.
—2 Desisting from.
—3 Restraint, check, forbearance.
संनिसर्गः Good-naturedness, gentleness.

संनिहित p. p.
—1 Placed near, lying close, near, contiguous, neighbouring; Ś. 4.
—2 Close, proximate, at hand; न पपात संनिहितपक्तिसुरभिषु फलेषु
 मानसम् Ki. 12. 4.
—3 Present; अपि संनिहितोऽत्र कुलपतिः Ś. 1; हृदयसंनिहिते 3. 19.
—4 Fixed, placed, deposited.
—5 Prepared, ready; Mu. 1.
—6 Staying or being in.

संनिहित + .{@-तम्@} Proximity, vicinity.
.━{@Comp.@}: संनिहितापाय

संनिहित + -अपाय a. having destruction close at hand, frail, perishable,
 transitory; कायः संनिहितापायः Pt. 2. 177.

सानिका, सानियिका, सानेयी
 A pipe, flute.

सानिका, सानियिका, सानेयी
 A pipe, flute.

—1 Vicinity, proximity; वदनामलेन्दुसांनिध्यतः Māl. 3. 5.
—2 Presence, attendance; परिकल्पितसांनिध्या काले काले च वन्दिषु
 R. 4. 6, 7. 3; Ku. 7. 33.

सांनिपातिक a. (-की f.) [संनिपातात् त्रिदोषविकारात्
 आगतः तेन निर्वृत्तो वा अण्]
—1 Miscellaneous.
—2 Complicated.
—3 Having a complicated derangement of the three bodily humours; वीर्यवन्त्यौषधानीव
 विकारे सांनिपातिके Ku. 2. 48; भिषजां सांनिपातिके कर्मणि व्यज्यते
 प्रज्ञा Pt. 1. 127.
.━{@Comp.@}: सांनिपातिककर्मन्
सांनिपातिक + -कर्मन् the treatment of the above illness.
